scope: Independent partial source/caller cross-check. Execution is recorded under parent B41; current-time CRL and document timestamp/capture concerns remain separate.

source.rule: For current UTC CRL checking, current UTC must be within the interval delimited by thisUpdate and nextUpdate.

Historical signer CRL requires capture before signer certificate expiry and nextUpdate after historical time; TSA path is checked at current UTC and revocation reason/time controls whether genTime is reliable.

candidate_1.verdict: likely consumer-level gap; avoid claiming generic timestamp establishment itself is defective
candidate_1.detail: Timestamp APIs return Established for Trust::Anchored and retain revocation separately. signature_timestamps_instant promotes at to BestSignatureTime without examining reason. That can use genTime where §12.8.3.4.8 requires current-time fallback. The TSA path must be checked at current UTC; NotChecked/indeterminate is not the no-revocation branch. Check all TSA path certificates; keyCompromise/cACompromise/missing reason forbids use; other reason allows only if revocation time > genTime.
limits: established_over is a document timestamp chain; separately resolve applicable §12.8.5.3 requirements before grouping it with the signature-attribute defect
no reason-specific runtime fixture was independently executed

candidate_2.verdict: context-dependent current-time gap candidate; not a global from_list defect
candidate_2.detail: from_list enforces at <= nextUpdate but not at >= thisUpdate. Shared API has no current/historical mode. Current-time §12.8.3.4.7 calls need lower-bound enforcement; historical §12.8.3.4.8 deliberately permits postdated CRLs when nextUpdate exceeds historical time and the capture/expiry condition holds.
candidate_2.counterexample: Existing a_list_issued_after_the_instant_asked_about_is_evidence_about_it is historical-style and valid under §12.8.3.4.8; a blanket lower-bound patch would break that behavior.
candidate_2.adjacent_source_condition: §12.8.3.4.7 also limits current-time OCSP evidence to a response captured before signer-certificate expiry; reviewer found no apparent wrapper. This is noted as adjacent scope, not analyzed as a third finding.
limits: no paired valid current-time CRL fixture drafted pending agreement on mode seam
other policy callers may define issuance semantics independently
